Aisha: Quick async pulse — Q2 OKR milestone check. Please drop a 1-line per owner: what shipped / what slipped / next step. Tag owners. Need this by EOD.
Liam: Shipped: runtime-v2 autoscale canary rolled out (10% → 50% started). Perf: p95 down ~120ms in most workloads. Owner: @liam. PR: #4321. Next: monitoring ramp & canary metrics review.
Sofia: Slipped: cache-dedupe rewrite. Blocker: test infra flakiness + token rotation edge-case. Owner: @sofia. Plan: isolate flaky tests and land small rollback patch to unblock downstream.
Noah: Dep note — Redis minor upgrade required for dedupe patch. Scheduling maintenance Thurs 02:00 PT. @sofia pls confirm compatibility matrix.
Aisha: @ruth can product/design accept a narrowed scope if dedupe slips (we might ship without second-order UX dedupe)?
Ruth: We can ship with the current UX surface. Will add a minor copy note explaining expected behavior. Not a hard blocker.
DeployBot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for runtime-v2 in us-west-2 (canary=10%) — track at: https://deploys.internal/reports/4321
Liam: CR ping — @sofia could you review my runtime-metrics cleanup? small perf guardrails, ~10 lines. Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4330 :eyes:
Sofia: On my list, will do within 2h. If I run into the test flake I'll ping infra.
Aisha: Thanks all. Quick housekeeping: owners, pls add your 1-line to /docs/q2-milestones.md by EOD. I'll consolidate for the exec snapshot. :thumbsup:
Noah: I'll post the maintenance window reminder in #eng-infra an hour before.
Liam: Noted. Also flagging that runtime canary showed a small increase in tokenization CPU for very short prompts — logging an issue: https://issues.internal/9876
Sofia: added a follow-up task to the dedupe ticket for test isolation. ETA for patch: Fri EOD if infra window holds.
Aisha: Perfect. If anything regresses in canary, roll back to v1 and ping me. Otherwise I'll stitch updates into the stakeholder note at 17:00 PT.
Ruth: I'll update the release notes snippet and drop it in the doc.
DeployBot: deploy-bot: canary -> 30% after health checks OK.
